authorityRules: Frontend and admin UI never decide owner, plan access, recipient resolution, delivery state, or permission outcome.
The notification service accepts only verified audiences and derives owner wallet from the principal.
Admin mutation and template routes require admin:notifications:manage.
Dead-letter redrive requires the same admin permission and only requeues a terminal job after an operator decision.
Publisher identity, inbox deduplication, and delivery admission are backend-only and remain disabled until N3/N4.
The BFF preserves the public plural /api/v1/notifications adapter while the service keeps the singular versioned path.
